package: @astryxdesign/core

# DropdownMenuItem

Use DropdownMenuItem inside DropdownMenu compound mode for one action or destination. Keep label, description, icon, and endContent non-interactive; controls belong in separate rows or the menu header/footer.

**Import:** `import {DropdownMenuItem} from '@astryxdesign/core/DropdownMenu';`

## Anatomy

| Element | Required | Description |
|---------|----------|-------------|
| Row | Yes | The role="menuitem" root that owns activation, disabled state, destination behavior, and theme state. |
| Content | Yes | The non-interactive label plus optional icon, description, and end content. |

## Best Practices

- **Do:** Use href for a destination so LinkProvider, modified clicks, middle clicks, and browser link affordances remain available.
- **Do:** Use hasCloseOnSelect=false only when activation reports a result in place on the same row.
- **Don't:** Put buttons, links, or other focusable controls inside label, description, or endContent. Each menu row is one interactive target.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `icon` | `IconType` | - | Icon to display before the label. See `astryx docs icons` for valid semantic names. |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | - | Primary label text. **(required)** |
| `description` | `ReactNode` | - | Secondary description text displayed below the label. |
| `onClick` | `(event: MouseEvent) => void` | - | Callback when the item is selected. A keyboard activation arrives as a synthesized click carrying the key's modifiers. On a row with `href` it runs before the browser navigates and is skipped for a modified click (⌘, Ctrl, Shift, Alt, middle button), which is left to the browser. |
| `href` | `string` | - | Address the row navigates to. The row then renders as a real anchor with role="menuitem" (through LinkProvider), so a modified click or a middle click keeps the browser's meaning — a new tab — instead of running onClick. |
| `target` | `'_blank' \| '_self'` | - | Link target. Only used with href. |
| `rel` | `string` | - | Link relationship. noopener noreferrer is added for target="_blank". Only used with href. |
| `isDisabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the row is unavailable. Disabled rows expose aria-disabled, remove link destinations, and suppress activation. |
| `endContent` | `ReactNode` | - | Non-interactive content rendered after the label and description. |
| `hasCloseOnSelect` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether activating the item closes the menu. Set false for an action that reports its result on the item itself. |
| `variant` | `'default' \| 'destructive'` | `'default'` | Visual variant. 'destructive' renders the label, description, and icon in the error color for dangerous actions (e.g. Delete). |
| `xstyle` | `StyleXStyles` | - | StyleX styles for layout customization (margins, positioning, sizing). Must be a stylex.create() value: not an inline style object like style={{}}. |
| `ref` | `React.Ref<HTMLElement>` | - | Ref forwarded to the row root, the element carrying role="menuitem". Register the row with an element-keyed observer or overlay. |

## Theming

| Component class | Preferred data attributes | Props | States |
|-----------------|---------------------------|-------|--------|
| `astryx-dropdown-menu-item` | `data-size`, `data-variant` | default, destructive | - |

Override in defineTheme:
```ts
components: {
  'dropdown-menu-item': {
    base: { /* CSS properties */ },
    'size:value': { /* variant-specific */ },
  },
}
```
